name: pi
description: A pi subagent type whose model steps run the pi CLI, so pi agents show in Claude Code's agent list, stream live and take follow-ups.

defaultModel.title: Default pi model
defaultModel.description: pi --model pattern used when a prompt has no pi-model line. Empty: pi's own default (defaultModel in ~/.pi/agent/settings.json).

timeoutMinutes.title: pi time limit (minutes)
timeoutMinutes.description: A pi run longer than this is stopped and its partial output returned.
